cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: Answer the Previous Question
cards.instruction: Redirect every dangerous question by sincerely answering an earlier, safer version of it.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'd like to keep this voluntary. You asked if lunch was good. The soup was excellent. Please.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: That was before I asked who ate my birthday cake.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm still in charge; we can make an adjustment. Excellent, but slightly salty. I hadn't finished my lunch review.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Forget lunch. Answer about the cake.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You also asked where we ate. That deserves a precise answer.

mechanism: A manages a meal conversation by accepting B chosen topic label while answering its earlier safe lunch-quality version to avoid a cake accusation.
confusable: Simple denial or random diversion does not preserve a specific prior question and answer it sincerely each time pressure rises.
comparison: Car alternative uses report order; this one makes hosting and food evaluation the cooperative cover.
seedUse: Soup seed establishes the earlier safe review; S02 needs tangible service or seating that responds to B instead of explaining the review order.
